candidate_datasets.name: MorphoSource

rationale: Shape is directly measurable and the drop model gives quantitative predictions. Public scans support a taxonomically restricted shape test, but paired mechanical variables are sparse, so the full causal claim is only partly resolvable.

candidate_datasets.name: Vascular Model Repository

candidate_datasets.name: Cardiac Atlas Project

candidate_datasets.name: Cardiac Atlas Project

candidate_datasets.name: Vascular Model Repository

candidate_datasets.name: The Cancer Imaging Archive

operationalization: Define demonstrability as out-of-sample predictive performance of mechanical morphology models versus coloration-function models across species, and compare effect sizes and uncertainty. This tests the contrast, though not the philosophical assertion in full.

candidate_datasets.name: MorphoSource
candidate_datasets.role: Open animal morphology for mechanical performance models.

candidate_datasets.name: Animal Coloration Database

candidate_datasets.name: MorphoSource

candidate_datasets.name: MorphoSource

candidate_datasets.name: Digital Morphology

candidate_datasets.name: MorphoSource

candidate_datasets.name: Dryad

candidate_datasets.name: MorphoSource
